brief:
Israeli occupation forces continued breaching the ceasefire agreement in Gaza for the 305th consecutive day, IMEMC News reported. The military carried out coordinated attacks across southern, central, and northern Gaza while maintaining a comprehensive blockade of the territory and tightening restrictions on movement and supplies.

A child died from wounds sustained during the ongoing violence. The violations mark an extended pattern of military operations that have persisted since the ceasefire took effect, with attacks reported across multiple zones of the strip despite the agreement intended to halt hostilities.
